scope: Local documentation notices at two viewports only; no product accessibility, timer behavior, independent review or acceptance proof

records.label: desktop

metrics.text:
The timing decision stays; a documentation correction awaits review.

Visitor access still ends after 30 minutes of inactivity or an authorized End, with no absolute conversation duration. The current UI documents mistakenly mix two accessibility options. WCAG's warning-and-extension option requires at least 20 seconds to act and at least ten opportunities to extend. Its separate pre-start adjustment option uses a range relative to the default duration. Ten extension opportunities is a minimum, not a cap on the visitor's conversation.

The controlling correction and review hold identifies the nine-source draft and frozen inputs. It has source/guard observations only; independent review and accepted successor authority are pending. The live contract and registry are unchanged. This notice does not implement a timer, accept the draft or extend earlier review receipts.

records.executionText: The latest authorized recovery-reference attempt failed reauthentication and returned no design IDs or previews. Connection and applicable allowance must be resolved before a separately approved retry. Current call counts stay in the B01 brief and ledger. The separate refusal-execution and timing-correction reviews remain held after the reviewer's terminal workspace-credit error; neither preparation has an independent execution/source-review verdict.
